Thanks Karen — great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the security/compliance track.

Call summary (high level)
- Goal: confirm Redwood Inference can meet Novum Health’s audit logging and data governance requirements for a pilot (PHI scope under discussion).
- Key asks from Novum: current SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture, sample admin/API audit logs and exportability, immutability guarantees, and vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) answers.

Action items / next steps
1) I will upload the VSQ template you sent and confirm ownership on our side (assigned to Karthik for technical, Dev for infra/legal fields).
2) Karthik to prepare a short export of admin + API audit events (anonymized) and a log schema + retention policy doc — expected by Monday (2026-05-24).
3) Dev to note where immutable append-only storage and tamper-evidence controls are implemented and provide a brief note for your security team.
4) We will schedule a 30-min follow-up (technical deep-dive) next week to walk through the sample logs and answer VSQ items.

Attachments: Novum_VSQ_Request.pdf (received from you during the call) — I’ve attached the original for reference.

Open questions we promised to confirm:
- Exact retention windows you require for admin vs API logs (let us know preferred values).
- Whether you need on-demand exports in a specific format (JSONL, CSV, or SIEM-compatible).

Thanks again — I’ll flag Karthik and Dev inline so you have direct contacts.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary and good call. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: we need confirmation of your current SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) and whether you have a SOC audit in progress.
2) HIPAA/GDPR: for the pilot we will be scoping a subset of workload with PHI; please confirm any BAAs you have and typical contractual language.
3) Logs: preferred export format is JSONL for ingestion into our SIEM; retention minimums: admin events 2 years, API events 1 year. Immutability requirement: we need assurance that exported logs are not altered and a hash-chain or signature can be provided if needed.
4) VSQ: please start the questionnaire. I attached a short VSQ template in today’s meeting materials.

Could Karthik share an anonymized JSONL sample and a short readme describing field names and timestamps? If Dev can provide a one-paragraph note on immutability (how you prevent in-place edits and retention enforcement), that would be perfect.

We’re aiming for an internal deadline of 2026-06-01 to finish evaluation for pilot kickoff, so the Monday delivery date works well.

Thanks,
Karen Li

Subject: RE: Deliverables: Novum sample logs + immutability note

Marissa / Karthik — uploaded the anonymized sample and short immutability note to the team drive. Summary below so we can paste into the VSQ answers: 

1) Sample export: redwood-auditlog-sample.jsonl (in Drive) — 200 lines, fields: event_type, actor_id (anonymized), resource_id, action, timestamp, request_id, src_ip (redacted), outcome, details. Format: JSONL, timezone UTC, timestamps RFC3339.

2) Immutability controls (one-paragraph):
Redwood writes audit events to an append-only store backed by WORM-enabled object storage (customer-dedicated buckets for Private/Dedicated or isolated prefixes for hosted). Exported batches are signed with an HMAC derived from a customer-specific key; we persist per-batch manifests and maintain an export audit table recording export hashes and timestamps. For retention enforcement we rely on immutable object lifecycle policies and independent retention enforcement in the metadata service — edits to historical audit files are not permitted by design.

3) SOC2 / BAA status: Legal confirmed we have a current SOC 2 Type II report (covering the inference platform and control plane) and we can provide a redacted report under NDA. We also have a standard BAA template used with healthcare customers; I attached the filename below.

Attachments uploaded: redwood-auditlog-sample.jsonl, redwood-immutability-note.txt, SOC2-Redacted-Process-Overview.pdf, BAA-template.docx
